title: Drones Company Equity Stake For Sale in Bengaluru, India
tagline: We’re a Bengaluru-based company specializing in indigenous drone technology, offering UAV solutions for various sectors like defense, security, surveillance, and environmental management. - Our expert team of 10 designs, develops, assembles, and customizes unmanned aerial vehicles tailored to meet specific needs. - We provide a range of products, including security and surveillance drones, live-streaming FPV drones, custom agricultural drones, seed-ball dispersal tech, as well as aerial survey and videography services. - The business currently serves 3–4 clients, including organizations across government, law enforcement, industrial, and educational sectors, along with CSR-funded environmental initiatives. - We’ve demonstrated our expertise through engagements with partners like defense units, Karnataka State Police, Western Railways, and other enterprises, confirming the demand for our solutions. - In our two years, we've reported revenues exceeding ₹30 lakh and currently have a project pipeline worth over ₹1.4 crore, indicating strong market interest. - Our revenue primarily comes from product sales, project-based services, tailored UAV development, and training, with potential maintenance contracts on the horizon. - We offer a unique opportunity for strategic buyers looking to dive into or expand their footprint in the growing drone technology sector, especially in aerospace and defense. - We hold a valid GST certificate.
